requested_changes.title: Root finite authority is pinned without validating or consuming its meaning
requested_changes.evidence: Registration and grant are only pin_file inputs. Their actor, decision, scope/input/current-source/phase/lease/budget and once-consumption bindings are not read. Hash-valid {} or authorization-false files can pass this admission. Outer-job claims are three asserted JSON values. Isolation only checks absolute roots and inequality with intake private root.
requested_changes.required_fix: Before output allocation, database access, spawn or product effects, consume an independently reviewed Root finite grant: exact registration/grant/input/source/binary/profile/route and actual argv/cwd/env/owned-root bindings, current lease, phase and once consumption, 3 requests (qualification 1 plus ordinary 2), requested tokens 8190 <= 8192, and real owned-job deadline/tree evidence. Canonical disjoint roots must reject aliases/reparse/subtree overlaps. NULL, false, foreign, consumed or mismatched authority must fail closed. New schema and actual Root producer remain proposals/OPEN until separately adopted.
minimum_verification: Hash-valid empty/false/foreign grant refuses before side effects.
Changing input/source/binary/route/root or replaying a consumed grant refuses.
A real matching Root schema has a reachable positive path without borrowed old STRICT authority.

requested_changes.title: Qualification, profile and provider facts do not close the causal graph of this trial
requested_changes.evidence: AVAILABLE is read from RuntimeRegistration, but the trial never associates the selected qualification run with runtime_qualification_runs and runtime_bindings sealed profile bytes, project, task, Goal, epoch, plan or actual qualification authority. Effects use run_id without project. UNKNOWN ledger validation is a minimum count; fact_refs hashes files and permits missing model_transport, and SSE completion is a substring check. Ordinary counting/witness does not independently bind the exact runtime/profile/read result to the selected qualification.
requested_changes.required_fix: Read and bind the real qualification/binding rows and sealed artifact raw bytes to this project/Goal/runtime/qualification run/profile/plan/epoch and current validity. Require project+run effect queries, exact provider-request/effect/ledger/fact associations, strict complete raw SSE/hash binding, and exact ordinary dispatch runtime/profile plus read1 path/body. Do not release the ordinary branch from a supplied AVAILABLE label or unrelated qualification. Missing actual evidence remains NOT_RUN and unknown billing remains NULL.
minimum_verification: Foreign project/runtime/old profile/ordinary run cannot substitute for qualification.
Swapped profile artifacts, wrong ledger request IDs, foreign effect rows or missing raw facts refuse.
A complete current qualification -> ordinary 2 MODEL + read1 causal graph is positively accepted by the independent evidence validator.

requested_changes.title: The next child is launched before checking the total deadline
requested_changes.evidence: command_once calls Popen before checking deadline in the polling loop. A qualification wait or previous stage can exhaust the 300-second budget and the next config/run child still launches. Fixed 2+2-second waits and final receipt/hash IO have no remaining-budget reserve. Spawn/drain failures can bypass a fully closed first-cause/raw invocation receipt.
requested_changes.required_fix: Check the real Root absolute monotonic deadline and remaining cleanup/evidence reserves before every spawn/side effect; bound waits and cleanup by remaining time and prohibit a later launch after exhaustion. Preserve one immutable first cause, original command/output and nullable exits for spawn/wait/parse/hash failures, with separate secondary failures and no retry. Actual outer owned-job evidence must prove the full Control/worker/CLI tree stopped within the authorized bound.
minimum_verification: Budget exhaustion during qualification or the preceding command produces no later child spawn.
Boundary remaining time and cleanup/evidence reserves are enforced.
Spawn/drain/finalization failure retains NULL exit facts and original first cause without retry.

requested_changes.title: Trial isolation is checked after mutable lease/database/host setup
requested_changes.evidence: Control acquires the data-root lease, opens/bootstrap/migrates the store and creates CurrentMu before the new partial/equal-vault rejection. Host.New creates host/private directories before selecting the readonly vault and its public Config entrypoint has no equivalent root-isolation rejection. filepath.Clean equality is case-sensitive and does not prove Windows alias/subtree separation.
requested_changes.required_fix: Validate the complete trial tuple and canonical Windows root separation before AcquireDataRootLease/store.Open/Bootstrap/NewCurrentMu and before Host.New mkdir/ACL/mutable-host setup. Apply the same guard to both Control flags and the Config entrypoint. Reject equality/case/reparse aliases and ancestor/descendant overlaps; preserve the original nontrial startup behavior and the sealed readonly old vault.
minimum_verification: Invalid partial/equal/case/junction/subtree configurations leave original DB/vault/ACL unchanged.
A genuinely isolated valid trial remains reachable.
Original nontrial startup and fixture qualification paths retain their behavior.
